verdict.rationale: Ramp explicitly advertises reimbursing employees in 70+ countries and 40 currencies with local-currency payout in two days or less, built directly into its reimbursements product rather than a separate international payments process, and supporting docs show mileage calculation and integration with expense capture workflows. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of cross-border payout speed and currency accuracy, and no detail on FX rate handling or edge-case countries.
